summary.text: Jami Cate is a Republican member of the Oregon House of Representatives for House District 11, which her legislative page associates with Lebanon.
Her biography describes her as a lifelong Lebanon resident and a fifth-generation Linn County farmer.

paragraphs.text: Cate raises grass seed with her family and operates a seed-cleaning warehouse that processes her farm's seed for shipping, according to her biography.
She graduated from Oregon State University with a degree in crop and soil science.
She has served on the boards of the Lebanon Strawberry Festival, the Lebanon Museum Foundation and the Lebanon Community Foundation.
